## Description
A concise summary of the proposed changes, added font families, or metadata corrections.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Font Family Addition (New open-source font)
- [ ] Font Update / Glyph Fix (Updated existing binary)
- [ ] Metadata / License Correction
- [ ] Tooling / Infrastructure Improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] The font is verified under an open-source license (OFL 1.1, Apache 2.0, or CC0).
- [ ] File sizes have been verified (ideally < 5 MB per binary).
- [ ] Passed repository scanner: `python Scripts/scan.py`
- [ ] Passed acceptance tests: `python Scripts/verify.py`
